rules.title: Security Deposit Limits and Requirements
rules.requirement: Landlords may charge at most one month's rent as a security deposit, must hold it in a separate interest-bearing account in a Massachusetts bank, provide a receipt and annual interest statements, and return the deposit (with interest) within 30 days after the tenancy ends, minus allowed deductions.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential tenancies in Massachusetts where a lessor collects a security deposit.
rules.penalty: Failure to comply with recordkeeping/receipt requirements entitles the tenant to immediate return of the security deposit; failure to pay interest allows tenant to deduct interest from next rent payment.
rules.quoted_span: No lessor or successor in interest shall at any time subsequent to the commencement of a tenancy demand rent in advance in excess of the current month's rent or a security deposit in excess of the amount allowed by this section.

rules.title: Security Deposit Return and Interest Requirements
rules.requirement: Landlords must hold security deposits in a separate interest-bearing bank account within Massachusetts, give the tenant a receipt within 30 days, and return the deposit with accrued interest within 30 days after the tenancy ends.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential tenancies in Massachusetts where a lessor collects a security deposit.
rules.penalty: Failure to comply entitles tenant to immediate return of the security deposit.
rules.quoted_span: Any security deposit received by such lessor shall be held in a separate, interest-bearing account in a bank, located within the commonwealth under such terms as will place such deposit beyond the claim of creditors of the lessor, including a foreclosing mortgagee or trustee in bankruptcy, and as will provide for its transfer to a subsequent owner of said property.
